# dusk bot

> Your own team of AI bots, in a chat app, on the AI accounts you already have. Free on your computer for personal use, and on dusk cloud they keep working with your laptop off.

## pages

- [dusk bot: the free Grok Bot alternative on your own AI](https://dusk.bot/): Your own team of AI bots, in a chat app, on the AI accounts you already have. Free on your computer, and on dusk cloud they keep working with your laptop off.
- [about / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/about): Who makes dusk bot and how it is built: AI bots you text like teammates, on the AI you already use, free for personal use.
- [acceptable use policy / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/acceptable-use): What you may not use dusk bot, its bots or dusk cloud desktops for, and what happens when someone does.
- [brand / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/brand): The dusk bot mark, the bots, the colours and a short description, for writing about dusk bot.
- [what's new / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/changelog): Every dusk bot release, newest first: what changed and what got fixed.
- [contact / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/contact): Write to the people who make dusk bot: help, security reports and privacy requests.
- [cookie policy / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/cookies): The few cookies and the local storage dusk.bot and the account pages use, what each is for, and your choices.
- [delete your account / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/delete-account): How to delete your dusk bot account, and what happens to your data.
- [download / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/download): Download dusk bot free for Mac, Windows and Linux, plus the iPhone and Android apps. Your bots, on the AI you already pay for.
- [license / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/license): The dusk bot license: free for personal use, what needs a work license, and the notices that come with the code.
- [pricing / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/pricing): Keep your bots working with your laptop off on dusk cloud, from $20 a month. The app is free for personal use, with every feature.
- [privacy policy / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/privacy): What dusk bot collects in the app, the phone app, the account service, dusk cloud and this site, why, and how to get it deleted.
- [refund and cancellation policy / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/refunds): How cancelling a dusk bot plan works, when you can get a refund, and how to ask for one.
- [security / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/security): How to report a security problem in dusk bot, what is in scope, and what to expect from us.
- [subprocessors / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/subprocessors): The outside services that process data for dusk bot, what each one does, and where.
- [terms of service / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/terms): The terms for using dusk bot: the app, accounts, paid plans, dusk cloud desktops, and what each side promises.

## docs

- [docs / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/docs): How to get going with dusk bot, and how to get the most out of your bots: clear jobs, good first messages, routines, group chats, memory and dusk cloud.
- [account and billing / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/account-and-billing): what's free, what plus and pro add, and how to pay, change or cancel. an account is only needed for a plan.
- [bots and chats / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/bots): making a bot, picking its ai, and talking to it while it works, by text or by voice.
- [a bot's computer / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/computer): a bot can have its own browser and desktop. watch it work, take the mouse whenever you like, and decide what it asks first.
- [dusk cloud / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/dusk-cloud): a computer we host for your bots, so they keep working with your laptop shut. the way we recommend once bots are part of your day.
- [questions / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/faq): the short answers, with a link to the long one.
- [files and apps / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/files-and-apps): give a bot files to work with, find what it made, and plug it into gmail, slack, notion and 60+ other apps.
- [getting started / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/getting-started): from nothing to a bot doing real work in about two minutes.
- [group chats / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/group-chats): put several bots in one thread and they hand work to each other. you step in when one needs a yes.
- [memory / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/memory): bots remember how you like things done. the notes are plain files you can read, edit and delete.
- [the phone app / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/phone): text your bots, answer their questions and get told when they're done, from anywhere.
- [privacy and your data / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/privacy-and-data): where your bots, chats and files live, what leaves your machine, and how to back up or delete everything.
- [routines / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/routines): ask once and a bot does it on a schedule, or the moment something happens.
- [tips for using bots / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/tips): the habits that turn a bot from a chat window into a teammate. short, with examples.
- [troubleshooting / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/troubleshooting): the things that go wrong most often, and what to do about each.
- [your own server / dusk bot docs](https://dusk.bot/docs/your-own-server): for people who already rent a server. paste one line and your bots live there, on around the clock.

## guides

- [Alternatives and comparisons, checked and dated / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/alternatives): Honest comparisons of AI agent apps: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Manus, Claude Cowork, Poke and more, with dated sources and who should pick what.
- [Glossary: AI agent words in plain English / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/glossary): Short, plain definitions of the words around AI agents and bots, each with an example of what it means in practice.
- [Guides to AI bots that work for you / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/guides): Plain-words guides to AI agents and bots: keeping them running with your laptop shut, scheduled AI tasks, group chats, safety and what it all costs.
- [Connect AI bots to the apps you use / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/integrations): What your bots can do in Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub and more: the real actions, what it asks first, and routines to copy.
- [Routines to copy: scheduled AI tasks that run for you / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/routines): Copy-ready routines for AI bots: the message to send, when it runs, what it needs and what it hands back. Paste one into a chat and it is set up.
- [What people hand to AI bots, by task and by role / dusk bot](https://dusk.bot/use-cases): Real jobs for AI bots, by task and by role: inbox triage, morning briefings, research, invoices, and routine packs for founders and small teams.
